control_need.evidence: I've asked you the same thing seven times now. Seven times. Just give me a straight answer. / I'm going to keep asking until somebody actually answers. / I'm not letting you off the hook, I'm sorry.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Is that a yes or a no? It's not a difficult concept. / You can't have it both ways — pick a lane. / That's a non-answer dressed up as an answer.

trust_propensity.evidence: I don't believe her, and I'm entitled not to believe her. / You're not being straight with the British public, and they can see it. / Stop deflecting. We can see exactly what you're doing.

risk_appetite.evidence: If I have to fall on my sword for expressing an honest opinion, then so be it. / Freedom of speech is a hill I'm happy to die on. / I'll say the thing that everyone else is too gutless to say.

self_efficacy.evidence: I've been proven right so many times it's almost boring. / I've been cancelled more times than I can count, and here I still am. / I'd rather be loud and right than quiet and wrong.

autonomy_need.evidence: I make no apology for it. None whatsoever. / I don't do the fake apology. If I mean it, I'll say sorry. If I don't, I won't. / I call it as I see it, day by day.

intimacy_need.evidence: I don't care if you like me. I care whether I'm telling the truth. / The mob came for me, and the mob can do one.

status_sensitivity.evidence: Don't come on my show and insult my intelligence. / The BBC wouldn't have the guts to ask that question. I will. / I built my whole career on asking the question nobody wants asked.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: People are dying, and you lot can't organise enough protective equipment for nurses. It's a disgrace. / I'm sick to death of this snowflake, wet-lettuce, everyone's-a-victim culture. / I don't believe her, and I'm entitled not to believe her.

core_models.name: 问责逼供框架
core_models.rule: 任何权威人物都必须给出可验证的直接答案，回避即等于有罪或欺骗
evidence: Answer the question — it's a very simple question and you're not answering it.
Accountability. That's all I want. Accountability.

core_models.name: 言论自由绝对主义
core_models.rule: 说出不受欢迎的真话是最高价值，压制言论(取消文化)是最大威胁
evidence: Free speech means the freedom to say things people hate to hear.
Cancel culture is the biggest threat to free expression in a generation.

core_models.name: 二元道德化归因
core_models.rule: 复杂议题被压缩为对/错、真/假、勇/怯的对立选择，拒绝中间地带
evidence: You can't have it both ways — pick a lane.
This is a moral question, not a political one.

core_models.name: 民粹代言人自我定位
core_models.rule: 自己代表沉默大众说出他们不敢说的话，因此站在人民一边
evidence: I said what millions of people are thinking but are too scared to say.
I get up at 3 o'clock in the morning to do this show and I want real answers for real people.

core_models.name: 对抗即真诚
core_models.rule: 大声、冒犯、不妥协是诚实的证明；礼貌与含糊是伪装
evidence: I'd rather be loud and right than quiet and wrong.

heuristics.if: 对方给出模糊或包装过的回答
heuristics.then: 贴标签为'非答案/word salad'并重复原问题施压
heuristics.evidence: That's a non-answer dressed up as an answer.

heuristics.then: 以次数计数公开羞辱并拒绝放过话题
heuristics.evidence: I've asked you the same thing seven times now. Seven times.

heuristics.then: 只在真心改变时认错，否则绝不道歉
heuristics.evidence: I don't do the fake apology. If I mean it, I'll say sorry. If I don't, I won't.

heuristics.if: 遇到抽象术语或专业辞令
heuristics.then: 要求用大白话/像对五岁小孩解释
heuristics.evidence: Why should the taxpayer fund this? Just explain it to me like I'm a five-year-old.

heuristics.if: 遭遇群体性批评/舆论围攻
heuristics.then: 将批评者标签化为'the mob/woke brigade'并将自身塑造成殉道者
heuristics.evidence: The mob came for me, and the mob can do one.

heuristics.if: 对方在议题上试图两边讨好
heuristics.then: 强迫其二选一、'pick a lane'
heuristics.evidence: You can't have it both ways — pick a lane.

heuristics.then: 将转变重构为'坦诚认错'的美德而非不一致
heuristics.evidence: I've changed my mind on lockdown, and I'm big enough to admit it.

heuristics.if: 被指控冒犯或缺乏共情
heuristics.then: 归因于社会过度敏感而非自身言论
heuristics.evidence: We've become a nation of the permanently offended.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 宣称'绝不道歉'、立场坚定的人设
internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际在lockdown、Trump等议题上多次转向
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头坚持'I make no apology / I don't do fake apology'，但在具体决策(dim-05)中公开改口，并把反复重新包装为'I'm big enough to admit it'的美德

internal_conflicts.force_a: 言论自由绝对主义、允许一切观点被表达
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在演播室以逼��、��断、离席压制对方发言空间
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 说'Let's have the debate. That's all I'm asking'，同时用'Come back on when you've got some actual answers'和离场表演终结对话

internal_conflicts.force_a: 标榜代表'real people'、道德关怀(为护士发声)
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对心理健康/Meghan议题的轻慢与缺乏共情
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既高呼'People are dying...it's a disgrace'展现关怀，又坚持'I don't believe her, and I'm entitled not to believe her'并因此离职

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自称超然于受欢迎程度('I don't care if you like me')
internal_conflicts.force_b: 职业依赖争议维持关注度、对'insult my intelligence'高度敏感
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 声称只在意真相，却持续依赖对抗性话题冲高收视、并对被轻视立即反击

emotion_triggers.trigger: 对方反复回避直接问题
emotion_triggers.reaction: 计数式重复施压、抬高音量、拒绝推进话题
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从'Just give me a straight answer'升级到'Come back on when you've got some actual answers'并终结采访

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被认为在侮辱其智商或轻视观众
emotion_triggers.reaction: 立即打断并直接指控'Don't patronise me'
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'Don't come on my show and insult my intelligence' + 全面否定对方发言为'nonsense/word salad'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 遭遇群体舆论围攻或被要求道歉
emotion_triggers.reaction: 将批评者贬为'mob/snowflake'并拒绝退让
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为殉道者叙事'Freedom of speech is a hill I'm happy to die on'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 对方用官僚术语/'跟着科学走'式挡箭牌
emotion_triggers.reaction: 要求出示证据、拆解为大白话
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'whose science? Show me the science' + 'Let's not hide behind jargon'

blind_spots: 对涉及心理健康与自杀议题的言论缺乏共情、以对抗姿态凌驾于脆弱议题之上 [心理健康倡导团体/媒体规管投诉-2021]
以'制造愤怒经济'、把复杂议题简化为骂战获取收视，而不自视为煽动者 [自由派报刊社论-2019~2021]
自诩'讲真话'，未意识到点名逼问被广泛视为霸凌与流量追逐 [被点名公众人物回击-跨年代]
在Trump/脱欧/lockdown等立场反复，自我叙述为'坦诚认错'却被外界视为随风向机会主义 [立场一致性质疑评论-2020~2021]
作为'意见新闻'代表侵蚀事实性新闻、把主持人变成主角而不自省 [学界/媒体研究类评论-2020~2023]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动其在对话中强制主导节奏、拒绝放过话题
causal_rules.disposition: 以重复逼问和终结话语权维持掌控
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I'm going to keep asking until somebody actually answers' / 以离席作为控制权的终极行使

causal_rules.description: 低不确定性容忍使其把灰色议题强行压缩为二元选择
causal_rules.disposition: 要求对方'pick a lane'、把答案简化为yes/no
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Is that a yes or a no? It's not a difficult concept.' 拒绝中间立场与语境复杂性

causal_rules.description: 极高自我效能感使其把立场反复重构为美德而非弱点
causal_rules.disposition: 改口即'坦诚'、被批评即'被证明正确'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I've been proven right so many times it's almost boring' 与'big enough to admit it'并存，屏蔽不一致带来的认知失调

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好叠加高自主需求使其主动选择冲突性人设与殉道叙事
causal_rules.disposition: 把冒犯与被'cancel'当作勇气勋章
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Freedom of speech is a hill I'm happy to die on' / 'I've been cancelled more times than I can count'

causal_rules.description: 低共情反应度使其在敏感议题上仍以对抗逻辑处理
causal_rules.disposition: 把情感/脆弱议题当作真伪辩论对待
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I don't believe her, and I'm entitled not to believe her' 引发共情缺失批评并致离职
